welcome.heroBadge: No install, no sign-in — just listen
welcome.heroParagraph: Echora is an immersive synced-lyrics player: pick a showcase track and instantly experience word-by-word lyrics, stage visuals, and playback controls. When you're ready, connect YouTube Music to load your own playlists.
welcome.heroKaraokeLine1: The lights rise for this line
welcome.heroKaraokeLine2: Every word lands on the beat
welcome.heroKaraokeLine3: The whole stage breathes with the melody
welcome.demoHint: "Start the demo" takes you to the showcase playlist. Already a returning visitor? Use "Open the player" above to jump straight to song selection.
welcome.demoScene1Line: The lights rise for this lyric
welcome.demoScene2Line: Every word lands on the beat
welcome.demoScene3Line: The chorus hits and the stage starts breathing
welcome.stagePreviewHint: During real playback, the lights, lyrics, and visual modes follow the music's rhythm — the above is just a quiet preview.
welcome.manifesto: Lyrics stop being text and start breathing with the beat — light, words and melody light up in the same instant, and the whole stage exists for this one song.
welcome.featureStageDesc: Word-by-word synced lyrics, AI-generated stage colors, and adjustable visual modes give every song its own breathing stage.
welcome.featureMusicDesc: Support YouTube Music private playlists and sign-in-free local showcase tracks; pick a song and step on stage.
welcome.featureInstallTitle: Install on phone, iPad, or desktop
welcome.featureInstallDesc: Install as a PWA to your home screen; every launch goes straight to song selection, skipping any intro page.
welcome.readyParagraph: No account needed — five royalty-free showcase tracks are ready. Once installed to your home screen, Echora starts right at song selection.
welcome.footerAttribution: AGPL-3.0 open source project · visual technology from
welcome.footerDataNote: Echora uses YouTube API Services: connecting a Google Account reads your playlists read-only, used solely to display and play them in the app, under the Google API Services User Data Policy, including Limited Use.
welcome.heroSub: An immersive word-by-word lyric stage, right in the browser — no install, no login, just listen.
welcome.actModesTitle: Scroll to relight the whole stage.
welcome.actModesHint: These are Echora's built-in visual engines rendering live — not screenshots.
welcome.actFeaturesTitle: The stage is set. It just needs your song.
welcome.featureAiDesc: Generates the stage colors and lyric tints from each song's mood, so every track gets its own lighting design.
welcome.featureControlDesc: Keyboard shortcuts, a command palette, lyric offset nudging and queue management — a stage should be easy to run.
welcome.iosInstallHint: iPhone / iPad: tap Share → Add to Home Screen in Safari.
welcome.lyricCredit: Lyrics are demo transcriptions; music under the Pixabay Content License.
welcome.mode_classic: The classic lyric stage — clean, focused, where every mode begins.
welcome.mode_cadenza: Lines pour out like a cadenza, trailing light behind them.
welcome.mode_lumiere: A dark stage lit by beams, with the lyrics standing in the light.
welcome.mode_tempera: Block-printed colour fields — every line develops panel by panel.
welcome.mode_partita: Lyrics arranged in voices that advance layer by layer.
welcome.mode_fume: Words surface out of drifting smoke, then dissolve.
welcome.mode_monet: Impressionist color washes across the whole stage.
welcome.mode_cappella: Pure as a cappella — nothing but words and light.
welcome.mode_pendolo: A pendulum sway; lines swing with the beat.
welcome.mode_sonnet: Typeset like a sonnet, breathing line by line.
welcome.mode_claddagh: Interlocking rings of light circling the lyric.
welcome.mode_diorama: A 3D diorama with the lyrics inside the scene.
welcome.mode_tilt: A stage that tilts with your perspective.
